what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sudan in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 87 Sudanese asylum seekers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 0.0% of all asylum seekers from Sudan.
Refugees from Sudan, a separate group, live mostly in Chad, South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan in periods from 1995 to 2025, with the RSF among the opponents since 2020.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 18 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2008.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the Democratic Republic of the Congo only.
